conventions: Units are metres; 1 unit = 1 m. +Y is up, characters face +Z, origin at the feet on the ground.
Humanoids share one rig: keep the bone names and pivot positions listed for each asset so the procedural animation (walk, attacks, deaths) keeps working.

The samurai are animated procedurally, joint by joint: feet are planted by leg IK, the spine bends at torso and chest, the head turns on the neck, and the soles stay flat via the ankles. Weight the mesh to those bones (a skinned glTF is ideal) and keep the knee, elbow and ankle pivots where they are.
Weapons: +Y runs from the grip toward the tip; the hand sits at the listed mount offset.
Colours are currently vertex colours on merged primitives; a reskin can use textures (PBR metal/rough).
Preferred delivery: glTF 2.0 (.glb), one file per asset, nodes named after the rig bones.
Keep triangle budgets mobile-friendly: up to roughly 3x the current counts shown here.

assets.name: Skeleton
assets.description: Weakest, slow, low health; arrives in large hordes.
assets.look: Bare bones: skull with dark sockets and teeth, ribcage, spine, pelvis, thin limb bones, a rag of loincloth.
animations: Death: Collapses into a pile of bones.

assets.name: Zombie
assets.description: Slower than skeletons but tough; hordes slightly smaller.
assets.look: Green-grey skin, hunched, torn kimono with a ragged hem and one torn sleeve, exposed ribs, sunken eyes, claws. Walks arms-out.
animations: Death: Falls over backwards with its hands up in the air.

assets.name: Witch
assets.description: Keeps short-medium range and casts homing spell orbs; backs away when approached.
assets.look: Long flared robe to the ground, shawl, pointed hat with a bent tip, long grey hair strands, long nose; staff with a glowing violet orb.
animations: Death: Leaves an empty pile of clothes; sometimes a spell collectible appears.

assets.name: Vampire
assets.description: Fast with short untouchable dashes every few seconds.
assets.look: Pale skin, slicked hair with widow's peak, red eyes, fangs, high stiff collar, long cape, crimson waistcoat with gold buttons and cravat.
animations: Death: Turns into a bat and flies away.

assets.name: Ghost
assets.description: Medium speed; fades in and out of visibility; drifts through walls and trees.
assets.look: Translucent flowing shroud with a wavy tattered hem, round head with hollow eyes and mouth, trailing arms; faint blue glow.
animations: Death: Fizzles out in a puff of ghostly vapour.

assets.name: Werewolf
assets.description: Very fast, hunts alone or in loose packs, lunges; heavy damage.
assets.look: Runs on all fours: heavy shoulders, shaggy mane and hackles, long snout with fangs, pointed ears, glowing yellow eyes, digitigrade legs, claws, bushy tail.
animations: Death: Slumps over onto its side.

assets.name: Demon
assets.description: Rare boss-like waves: very high health and speed; turns the sky to night; camouflaged in the dark; throws fireballs.
assets.look: Large (about 1.55x scale), dark red skin, curved horns, glowing orange eyes, spine spikes, chest plates, clawed hands and feet, loincloth, tail.
animations: Death: Burns away, shrinking in a burst of embers.
